# Pre-market brief — Thu 2026-10-22 (as of ~8:25 AM ET)

1. **Oil spike + Mideast escalation.** Houthi attacks hit Saudi infrastructure (Shaybah field, Dammam airport); Brent >$112, WTI near $100; US ordered non-emergency embassy staff out of Saudi Arabia. Airlines stay in avoid (AAL guided to deeper losses, about −4% pre). Energy names up 1–2% pre. [Morningstar/DJ](https://www.morningstar.com/news/dow-jones/202610223696/north-american-morning-briefing-stock-futures-tumble-mideast-tensions-push-oil-higher) · [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nasdaq-futures-slide-premarket-ai-111659890.html) · [X news](https://x.com/i/trending/2113163578438045802) · [CNBC live](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)
2. **Futures down, AI-capex fear back.** Nasdaq-100 futs about −1.7 to −1.9%, S&P about −1.1%. Treasury yields fell, dollar at a 3-week low, gold −1%. [Reuters/Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/nasdaq-futures-drop-over-1-as-ai-worries-resurface-oil-climbs-4965180) · [Morningstar/DJ](https://www.morningstar.com/news/dow-jones/202610223696/north-american-morning-briefing-stock-futures-tumble-mideast-tensions-push-oil-higher)
3. **Megacap prints sold.** TSLA about −3% pre (beat, but capex cut to ~$20B, battery constraints). META −2% (beat; first negative FCF in a decade, new non-voting share class). LRCX −7% (in-line guide). IBM −5% (beat, raised FCF). [CNBC movers](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/22/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-tsla-meta-avex-spot.html) · [WSJ](https://www.wsj.com/livecoverage/stock-market-today-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-10-22-2026) · [X: META](https://x.com/i/trending/2113112339415269633)
4. **Beats bid:** LMT +3% (Q3 EPS $7.97 vs $7.52, FY guide raised again, record $292B backlog). PG +2% (core EPS $2.00 vs $1.89, sales +4%). TXN beat with a Q4 guide above estimates. Losers: ROL −5% (miss), LVS −2% (miss). [CNBC movers](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/22/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-tsla-meta-avex-spot.html) · [X: LMT](https://x.com/i/trending/2113222562834735223) · [X: PG](https://x.com/i/trending/2113232866767163424) · [X: TXN](https://x.com/i/trending/2113023577179996586)
5. **BTC** is holding $80–85k, with $528M of spot ETF inflows Oct 21. [X news](https://x.com/i/trending/2113125830469820504)

**Calendar:** jobless claims 8:30 today. Flash PMIs and UMich Fri. FOMC Oct 28. Earnings: AXP/SLB Oct 23 BMO; V Oct 27; MSFT/GOOGL Oct 28; AMZN Oct 29; AAPL Nov 2 AMC ([Apple IR](https://investor.apple.com/investor-relations/event-details/2026/FY-26-Fourth-Quarter-Results/default.aspx)).

**Swing ideas (long-only)**
- **LMT**: beat-and-raise plus a defense bid as the Gulf escalates. Conf: med. Risk: gap fades if de-escalation headlines hit.
- **PG**: beat, guide intact; defensive staples in a risk-off, inflationary tape. Conf: low. Risk: input costs from oil; snaps back if tech rebounds.
